title: Offline Nametag Icon
description: A mod to add customizable nametag icon or badge to your player.
body:
# Offline Nametag Icon

A mod that adds a customizable nametag icon/badge above your own player, similar to popular PvP clients. Works with offline accounts as well.

> **Minecraft 1.21.11+ (v3.0.0 and newer):** Your own nametag is rendered by the mod itself, so no additional mods are required.

> **Older Minecraft versions:** To see your own nametag with the icon, install the [Who Am I](https://modrinth.com/mod/whoami) mod.

![Preview In-Game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/bxqsTc3n/images/bc039032521da3124fcc89ffd60557600e9e422d.png)

## customizing the icon

Download the template resource pack from [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/offline-nametag-icon-tempelate), edit:

```
assets/minecraft/offlinenametagicon/badge.png
```

and place the resource pack in your game's `resourcepacks` folder.
